steps.what: Establish site requirements and reconcile source quantities
Prepare sketches, working drawings and technical specifications
Calculate proposed budgets from checked quantities and prices
Draft reports and proposals around the engineering design

loop.purpose: Draft the explanatory sections of the project package
loop.input: Checked requirements, drawing references and budget rows
loop.check: Engineer checks every technical statement, number and qualification against the sources
loop.stop: One revision; write unsupported sections manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Project explanations vary beyond fixed headings

steps.what: Check design package consistency and correct engineering errors

tasks.design: Configure reusable drawing details in {OTHER}, the existing CAD application, and quantity-price formulas in {SPREADSHEET}. A bounded drafting loop prepares explanatory sections in {DOCS}; the engineer retains design decisions and checks the complete package.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drawings, quantities and narrative were assembled separately for each project.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing CAD detail libraries and spreadsheets can reuse specified project inputs; prose drafting is an E1 design hypothesis.
tasks.still_hard: Soil variability, load assumptions, constructability and unsuitable standard details require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Accept responsibility for the engineering relationships across the documents.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time repeating document assembly and more time resolving site constraints.

reach.learn: Keep quantity revisions and quotation dates visible

evidence.claim: Relatics supports requirements and verification management; this does not establish CAD or drafting savings.
The proposed CAD reuse, budget formulas and narrative assistance have unmeasured local labour effects.

assumptions: Preparation ends at a checked package; distribution is not stated and is not added. The package is the existing design deliverable, not a new activity log.

The engineer produces project ID, units, quantity, price, quotation date, exclusions and drawing revision in s1; all capture and reconciliation time stays there. Missing or incompatible fields return to manual budgeting.

CAD detail insertion removes 3.5 hours of repeated standard geometry and annotation from s2, retaining 31.5 hours of project geometry and specification judgement. It does not reuse unsuitable details.
The author saves ordinary working files in the same applications during these steps; no new approval or saving benefit is attached to that save.
unknowns: Availability of compatible standard drawing details
Whether current budget formulas already eliminate calculation labour
research_questions: On recent comparable projects, how much manual quantity-price calculation and standard-detail redrawing actually remains?

already_counted.description: Engineer checks narrative and cross-document engineering consistency

incremental.description: Maintain drawing detail versions and budget formula tests

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=73.5: 3.5 drawing hours, 15 budget hours and 8 narrative hours removed, less 3 upkeep gives 23.5 net. Conservative case: incompatible layers retain 34 of 35 drawing hours; mostly existing budget automation retains 12 of 15; bespoke technical prose retains 17 of 20; other 30 retained and 3 upkeep gives 4 net. Comparable detail libraries and reliable quantities could retain 32 drawing, 5 budget and 14 narrative hours plus other 30 and 1 upkeep, giving 18 net. No vendor cycle-time multiplier is transferred.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe sites and consult about construction problems

steps.what: Locate current plans and unresolved site problems before visiting
Visit sites and observe environmental conditions and construction activities
Consult contractors about observed problems and feasible responses
Annotate observed problems on the existing site issue record

tasks.design: Use the native project index in {DOCS} to locate current references and retain an existing issue form with project headings. The engineer visits, interprets conditions, consults contractors and writes the site-specific observations.
tasks.previous_blocker: References and issue headings were repeatedly located or retyped.
tasks.enabler_now: A current-document view and reusable issue headings need no model or new site sensor.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden conditions and contractor constraints cannot be resolved by document reuse.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise consequential site conditions and communicate proportionate responses.
tasks.altitude: Reduce reference handling while retaining site attention.

reach.learn: Tie observations to a specific location and drawing revision

evidence.claim: Native document indexing and reusable headings can reduce navigation and retyping; the local amounts are assumptions.

assumptions: This case has an existing issue record used by the engineer on the next visit; no trailing visit report or extra distribution is introduced. If no such record exists, s4 has no eligible baseline.
The engineer selects current revision and unresolved query references in s1 and captures location, observation and response in s4; their time is counted. Missing metadata is resolved manually.
The index removes 2 of 10 lookup hours. Form headings remove 1 of 10 annotation hours; the nine hours of site facts and judgement remain. These are different operations and different cuts.
No new routine upkeep is required beyond maintaining current references within s1. Ordinary author saves remain fully retained in s4.
unknowns: Whether current references are reliably indexed
Whether the engineer actually maintains the assumed issue record
research_questions: Do observed visits include the specified reference search and issue annotation today?

already_counted.description: Capture and check site-specific issue facts

incremental.description: No separate recurring work for native views and fixed headings

approvals.approved_version: The exact response or instruction spoken to the contractor; new observations require reconsideration before speaking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=97, zero upkeep gives 3 net. Conservative case: poorly labelled revisions require all 10 lookup hours and the existing issue note already has headings, retaining all 100 hours, giving zero. If the index removes 1.5 lookup hours and existing issue headings remove 0.5 annotation hours, 98 hours remain and 2 net is possible. Site travel, observation and consultation remain unchanged in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review existing client needs and project context
Meet clients to discuss needs, constraints and competing priorities
Write elicited needs into the working project brief
Check that the written brief distinguishes needs from unresolved preferences

tasks.design: Keep the client conversation human and use the existing project brief in {DOCS} with reusable sections for needs, constraints and open questions. A native project view shortens retrieval; the engineer writes and checks the actual requirements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prior correspondence and repeated brief structure consume preparation and writing time.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document views and brief headings support modest reuse without recording or transcribing the meeting.
tasks.still_hard: Clients may express conflicting aims or leave essential constraints unstated.
tasks.human_edge: Probe assumptions and build a trustworthy understanding of the client's priorities.
tasks.altitude: Preserve conversation quality while reducing repeated brief assembly.

reach.task: Use the needs brief to scope delivery
reach.learn: Preserve unresolved requirements rather than imply agreement

evidence.claim: Existing document headings and project views can remove repetitive setup without deciding client needs.

assumptions: The engineer already updates a working needs brief used for design scoping. It is split from meeting time; no extra minutes, CRM record or client confirmation send is invented.
The engineer produces the needs, constraints, ownership and open-question fields in s3 from s2; capture and checking remain priced. Free-form or ambiguous needs remain manually written.
A project view removes 1 hour of retrieval from s1. Reusing the brief's headings and stable project description removes 3 writing hours from s3; the remaining 17 hours are client-specific writing.
This is an ordinary internal author save with no approval gate. Stable headings need no separate recurring upkeep beyond the retained brief work.
unknowns: Whether brief creation already uses the proposed headings
How much current preparation involves retrieval
research_questions: Does the current working brief contain enough repeated structure to remove three hours per hundred baseline hours?

already_counted.description: Write and check the client-specific needs brief

incremental.description: No additional recurring administration for fixed native headings

approvals.approved_version: The specific engineering statements and commitments voiced to the client, reconsidered whenever scope or constraints change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=96, zero upkeep gives 4 net. Conservative case: correspondence cannot be indexed comparably and the brief is already templated, retaining all 100 hours and zero benefit. For a partially reusable brief, retain 9.5 preparation hours and 18 brief-writing hours plus all 70 conversation and checking hours, giving 2.5 net. No conversation shortening is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate plans with stakeholders and make necessary changes

steps.what: Locate plans and identify the questions requiring discussion
Discuss plans and evaluate proposed changes with project stakeholders
Make necessary changes to the working plans
Check changed geometry and specifications against evaluated decisions

tasks.design: Use the native current-revision view in {DOCS} and compatible detail blocks in {OTHER}, the CAD application. Stakeholders evaluate the plans in conversation; the engineer separately makes and checks the necessary drawing changes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Revision hunting and redrawing unchanged standard details take time around the substantive evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native revision views and reusable CAD blocks can remove those specific operations.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding which change is safe, affordable and responsive to stakeholders remains engineering work.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve conflicting requirements and recognise consequences across the design.
tasks.altitude: Keep evaluation and change authorship visible while reducing repeated navigation and geometry.

reach.learn: Use compatible layer conventions and preserve the evaluated revision

evidence.claim: Relatics supports engineering requirements and verification; the proposed native CAD changes and their labour effects remain E1.
Compatible CAD blocks can remove repeated geometry without evaluating a design change.

assumptions: The portfolio includes discussion and the necessary working-plan changes stated in the task. No additional meeting minutes, approval record or issued-plan send is introduced.

The engineer selects revision and questions in s1 and determines the exact location, dimensions, units and specification changes in s2 and s3; capture is counted. Missing dimensions or incompatible layers require manual edits.

Revision indexing removes 3 of 15 search hours. Reusable detail blocks remove 3 of 30 editing hours; the retained 27 hours contain project-specific changes. Both cuts require observed manual work today.
Ordinary author saves are retained without a self-approval stage. If the same plan drafting is charged to 5336, allocate this change work only once.
unknowns: Whether the CAD library matches the projects' layer conventions
How much plan changing currently occurs during this task
research_questions: Can a sample of actual change sets distinguish revision search, repeated detail edits and unique engineering work?

already_counted.description: Check revised plans against evaluated change decisions

incremental.description: Maintain compatibility of reused CAD detail blocks

approvals.approved_version: The exact proposed changes and technical statements discussed with external stakeholders; changed assumptions require reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=94, gross 6 less 1 upkeep gives 5 net. Conservative case: most revisions are poorly labelled and layer incompatibility prevents detail reuse; retain 14 search hours, all 30 editing hours and other 55 hours, with 1 upkeep giving zero. With reliable revision metadata removing 2 search hours and compatible detail blocks removing 2 editing hours, retain 96 hours and 1 upkeep gives 3 net. No shared percentage reduction is applied to the two configure steps.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain site judgement and client understanding while reducing repeated engineering document work.
reach: Connect needs, site observations and design revisions
Work with estimators and drafters on traceable inputs
skills_to_grow: Trace quantities and requirements across revisions

role.ambitious_version: An agricultural engineer who spends more of the existing project effort on local constraints and feasible designs.
